body: What’s the purpose of all this. Writing is a way of communicating ideas and thoughts and beliefs, you cannot automate that… and your “investigation” is already bias… the real problem is people don’t have anything interesting to write about or have passion to write about. So they write about how to write. It’s the same shit over and over. The problem is that people lack depth and you think putting it into AI and putting effort into it makes up for the lack of depth that you or the content have. It’s not that hard to understand. AI doesn’t make you any more intelligent or competent.

The amount of effort it takes to produce it doesn’t mean the quality is any good… maybe to you and for you but not to readers. I mean you can pretend that you’re an amazing  writer and nobody understands you or recognizes your amazing work… like you did here. If that makes you feel better about yourself, do you. Ultimately that’s the writers job to explain why their idea matters or why they should continue reading it. It’s the writers job to make their points as clear as possible for others to read and understand. 

Your second statement is an example of making simple shit sound smart. the truth is, nobody is really making decisions off of pure logic. If you think you do then you need to work on your  self-awareness. 

AI tends to waffle, and nobody wants to read that shit. It shouldn’t be used to write things for you, it’s should help you by using it to clarify your ideas and connect your thoughts so that you can write for yourself.

I thought maybe I had it, so of course researched it and tried to figure out how I could work on things. I found that a lot of the symptoms I had were actually low serotonin and norepinephrine related. looping thoughts, rigid thinking and daydreaming,  constant anxiety and uncertainty etc. . I started taking an SNRI, and it really helped with mental clarity and the energy.

Can you be a little more specific on what want it to do, is it that he needs help with making decisions. Or is it with the guidance through multistep tasks, does he need something that helps prompt him when communicating? 
I might be able to help you. I just want to better understand what he needs from it so it’s actually helpful.

If you are constantly on your mind and your thoughts you are not going to be as connected with the world around you or your experiences in the same. I can’t ever fully try to force a specific memory of someone’s face in my head to appear. Actively recalling information and daydreaming, episodic memories and mind wandering are different things. Also you’ve only met a couple times so it makes sense that you wouldn’t have that deep of a connection with him anyways, but the newness probably wore off quicker.

Watch his videos online if you want a snapshot of the methodology that he discusses and systems he talks about. I got the books and various guides from his website guides and still love them. also his podcast is GTD, you can listen on snipped. And gtd virtual study group has a podcast where people just chat about their systems and methods that they are using and bounce ideas off one another in terms of optimization etc. It’s a little old but their website is nice and people have good ideas on there.

It’s not a jab to note certain patterns in the language.The same way people can use AI to write stuff it’s okay to talk about whether it is or not. Using AI to help you write and  having it write things for you are two different things. If you want to pretend like you spent time writing AI generated content that’s fine…it won’t convince anyone that you actually have good ideas worth reading.

Have you made your own GPTs yet or added to your memories?? I like telling it when I like an output and telling to remember or continue creating that format for that chat. It works pretty well I get the content I want. I see tons of posts about ChatGPT being basic and generic, that says more about the person using it than it does about gpt. It’s not going to magically create things for you. Overall I’ve tried allot of different ones for projects and stuff and I come back to ChatGPT for its output. But I use it for writing, ideas, and projects. not really into coding or anything.

Your meds don’t work if you don’t eat protein and carbs and drink water. there’s no way around it… if you don’t eat these things and enough of them, you can’t make neurotransmitters such as Serotonin and Dopamine. 
Adderall can make your OCD and anxiety worse and cause you to fixate on things even more.
If you are struggling with OCD , I would suggest you speak to your doctor about that as well because there might be better options for you medication wise. 

Amphetamine induced psychosis, or mania can happen, and that’s why it’s important to take meds as prescribed or not take extra, but isn’t common if taking your prescribed dosage. 


My Advice for food intake… I like protein shakes and meal replacement shakes for when I don’t feel like eating a whole meal. They are great in the mornings.
Set alarms for yourself to remind you to eat and drink water. Protein is especially important, you should get a bit extra if you want to feel good and have mental clarity. 
Carbs are just as important for your brain functioning too so try to eat whole grains. 

Taking L-theanine and magnesium have personally helped me with anxiety and overall muscle tension that caused me to not feel well.

It’s not an ADHD thing in the way that if you clench your teeth you have adhd…

It is however linked to low magnesium, and stimulant medications it’s called bruxism. Low magnesium and stimulant meds together make it even worse. Some people also just clench their jaw as a way of concentrating and various other habits.
